# ShadowScan producer fixture

`cyclonedx-agent-model.json` is synthetic and was generated by the actual
`render_cyclonedx` reporter in Nexus-ShadowScan commit
`aa3577e169cbb8570c66c8f5f893f835bf8dc527`. It is a compatibility fixture,
not a production scan or evidence of detection accuracy. It was generated from
a manually constructed `Finding`: surface `CODE`, kind `AGENT`, connector
`code.filesystem`, title `synthetic`, resource `synthetic-agent`, resource type
`repository`, and model `example/model:1`. The enclosing `ScanResult` used a
completed `code.filesystem` `ScanStats`, with start and finish timestamps set
to `2026-01-01T00:00:00Z`.

Regenerate in a reviewed checkout of that commit with its dependencies installed:

```python
from shadowscan.models import Finding, Surface, Kind, ScanResult, ScanStats
from shadowscan.reporters.cyclonedx import render_cyclonedx

f = Finding(surface=Surface.CODE, connector="code.filesystem", kind=Kind.AGENT,
            title="synthetic", resource="synthetic-agent", resource_type="repository",
            models=["example/model:1"])
s = ScanResult(findings=[f], stats=[ScanStats(connector="code.filesystem",
               started_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")],
               started_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", finished_at="2026-01-01T00:00:00Z")
print(render_cyclonedx(s))
```
